object_description: three connected low-rise volumes beneath a large flat roof
design_condition: Three volumes are connected by covered arcades and organized as a large figure that opens the waterfront while stepping into the graduated terrain.

positive.statement: Differentiated outdoor spaces and convincing spatial transitions and relationships are created within the complex.
The classroom arrangement is convincing because of its operational autonomy and the beautiful outdoor spaces in front of it.
The building base cleverly integrates the facility under the large roof into the graduated topographical context.
The project has a plausible wooden building structure and is carefully designed structurally.
The green garden framed by the arcade forms a beautiful motif and a prelude to the hard court.
The lakeshore is opened and differentiated outdoor spaces interact productively with the existing building.

negative.statement: The new figure seems too large in relation to the existing building and too bulky in the context.
The proximity to the main building and the corner near the workshop building appear cramped.
The very large flat roof is too clearly visible and appears too dominant.
A direct connection from the classrooms to the outside area would have been very desirable.
The location of the stairs in relation to the new house is not convincing.
The hard court is very large and entirely hard-surfaced, while its transitions to the parkland are undervalued.
